Abstract

The WebMCP API enables web applications to provide tools to AI agents.

Status of This Document

This document is a draft specification.

Introduction

An agent can invoke tool definitions.

This is an informative note for WebMCP implementers.

API 


partial interface Navigator {
  [SecureContext, SameObject] readonly attribute ModelContext modelContext;
};

The provideContext(options) method steps are:

  1. Initialize the context map.
  2. Register each tool entry.
navigator.modelContext.provideContext()

Registers all tools with the browser.
